name: Cloud & OpenAI-Compatible AI Integration

name_i18n.tr: Bulut ve OpenAI Uyumlu AI Entegrasyonu

author: AiPBX Official Team
description: Connect cloud providers (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Azure, Polly) or any remote self-hosted AI server using OpenAI-compatible schemas (vLLM, Ollama, Faster-Whisper, Kokoro) for STT, TTS, LLM, and Voicemail AI.

description_i18n.tr: Bulut sağlayıcıları (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Azure, Polly) veya farklı bir sunucuda çalışan OpenAI şeması uyumlu (vLLM, Ollama, Faster-Whisper) AI servislerini STT, TTS, LLM ve Sesli Mesaj özeti için bağlar.
description_i18n.en: Connect cloud providers (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Azure, Polly) or any remote self-hosted AI server using OpenAI-compatible schemas (vLLM, Ollama, Faster-Whisper, Kokoro) for STT, TTS, LLM, and Voicemail AI.
